title: Seven days have arrived
next_chapter_hook: Ye Qing released a Demonic Path pressure with a cold smile, and Chen Ji's Mental Sea hourglass had finished one shichen—the remaining time was passing at an almost cruel speed.

text.content:
Seven days have arrived.

The morning mist had yet to disperse, but the sky beyond the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate was already shrouded by a bizarre purple-black aura. The Demonic Path's 'Xuanming Cloud Barrier' blotted out the sun, enveloping the entire sect in a suffocating oppression. In the distance, several figures hovered in mid-air. The leader wore a ink-colored silk dress, with frost-like brows and eyes, and demonic energy surged around her like substance—it was Ye Qing, the Holy Sect Saintess of the Demonic Path.

Her voice was not loud, yet it clearly entered the ears of every Tianqing Sect disciple: 'Chen Ji, the seven-day agreement has arrived. I've come personally—can you hide?'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, this is your last chance. Hand over the Tianji Record Fragment, and I'll ensure you a whole corpse.

text.content:
Before the Tianqing Sect Council Hall, the elders' faces were ashen, yet no one dared to speak first. They had long heard of the Demonic Path Holy Saintess's reputation—it was said she alone had massacred three medium-sized sects in the Northern Territory, her methods so ruthless that righteous cultivators shuddered at her name.

Su Qingyao, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, stood at the front of the crowd, her beautiful eyes fixed on a gray-robed servant disciple standing in the corner. She had known for a long time that today's disaster was inextricably linked to this person.

In the corner, Chen Ji's expression was calm, even a faint smile playing at the corner of his lips. Deep in his Mental Sea, a grain of sand finer than dust was slowly falling—that was the 'Death Hourglass' left behind after the Tianji Record consumed Heavenly Fate. Three hours, from the moment he decided to keep the appointment, the countdown had begun.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, the Demonic Path Holy Saintess came in person—this matter exceeds what our Tianqing Sect can handle alone. If you have anything to say, speak now.

text.content:
Old Patriarch Ling Yuan's words sounded like concern, but Chen Ji caught the fleeting glee in his eyes. This old fox was hoping he'd be humiliated before the Demonic Path, so he could rightfully expel him from the sect.

A cold smile formed in Chen Ji's heart: I've noted this. Wait for the right moment.

He gently pushed through the crowd, walking step by step toward the Mountain Gate. With each step, the hourglass in his Mental Sea trembled slightly. 1 hour 59 minutes... 1 hour 58 minutes... Time passed silently, yet not a trace of anxiety showed on his face.

'Holy Saintess,' Chen Ji stopped before the Mountain Gate, looking up to meet Ye Qing hovering in mid-air, his voice neither servile nor overbearing, 'The seven-day agreement, Chen has never forgotten. But I wonder—did the Saintess come to take Chen's life, or to negotiate a deal?'

dialogue.content: A deal? As a Foundation Building初级trashtrash, you dare negotiate with this Saintess?
The Saintess should not be impatient.

text.content:
Chen Ji unhurriedly took out a pitch-black Jade Slip from his sleeve, gently rotating it between his fingers. That was a 'Projection Fragment' cast by the incomplete Tianji Record—a special item he had exchanged 5 Heavenly Fate points for, usable only once.

'That envoy behind the Saintess,' Chen Ji smiled faintly, his gaze passing over Ye Qing to fall upon a Demonic Path expert in black robes behind her, 'If Chen's guess is correct, within seven breaths, he will step on a loose blue stone with his right foot, then fall face-first in front of everyone.'

At these words, the entire crowd erupted. The Demonic Path envoy flew into a rage: 'Arrogant fool!'

However—

One breath.

Two breaths.

Three breaths.

The Demonic Path envoy coldly snorted, lifting his foot to charge down the Mountain Gate. But on the fourth breath, his right foot happened to land on a loose blue stone soaked with morning dew. The stone tilted, his body suddenly lost balance, and he pitched forward, falling hard on the stone steps before the Mountain Gate, biting a mouthful of mud.

Complete silence fell over the entire area.

Ye Qing's pupils suddenly contracted. She looked down at the envoy scrambling up from the ground, then looked up at Chen Ji, her gaze gaining a weight it had never held before.

She knew what this meant. The Tianji Record—that legendary forbidden artifact, was actually in thistrash's hands.

Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, his smile undiminished, but cold intent had already leaked into his eyes: 'Does the Saintess think this qualification is enough to negotiate a deal?'

In the Mental Sea, the hourglass fell silently: 1 hour 51 minutes.

dialogue.content: Interesting. What deal do you want? Speak.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's interest had been piqued, and Chen Ji needed to prove he deserved an equal alliance with her. The three-hour death limit was ticking away—he had to make a choice—

choices.description: Show Ye Qing the internal conspiracy of the Demonic Path Holy Sect predicted by the Tianji Record, proving your intelligence value, and sign an equal alliance.
choices.visible_cost: Consume Tianji Record prediction attempts (Heavenly Fate -5)
choices.visible_reward: Gain intelligence advantage over the Demonic Path Holy Sect, establish equal dialogue status with Ye Qing
choices.risk_hint: Expose part of the Tianji Record's abilities, may attract covetous attention from higher powers

dialogue.content: The Saintess came from afar, so Chen has naturally prepared a small gift.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised that pitch-black Jade Slip, saying calmly: 'Does the Saintess wish to know what your good senior brother—the Holy Sect's Great Protector—has been saying to the Holy Master recently?' Ye Qing's expression suddenly darkened, a complex emotion of fear and fury flickering in her eyes. The堂堂 Demonic Path Holy Saintess, actually shaken by a Foundation Buildingtrash's words. In the Mental Sea, hourglass: 1 hour 47 minutes.

choices.text: Expose the insider by borrowing external power
choices.description: Use the Demonic Path Holy Saintess's hand to expose the fact that the insider elder of Tianqing Sect was secretly colluding with the Holy Sect—kill two birds with one stone.
choices.visible_reward: Eliminate the sect insider, enhance actual control within the sect
choices.risk_hint: The insider may turn desperate and attack Chen Ji on the spot

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze casually swept across the crowd, pausing for a moment on a gray-haired elder—Elder Zhou, Ling Yuan's personal disciple. At his sleeve's edge, a corner of black underwear embroidered with the Demonic Path Holy Sect's mark was faintly visible.

dialogue.content: The Saintess's 'old friend' in this sect is also present today.

choices.text: Feign weakness to draw out the snake
choices.description: Deliberately show weakness, making Ye Qing lower her guard, enticing her to reveal her true purpose, secretly recording evidence.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Ye Qing's verbal confession, master the full picture of her intentions, lay groundwork for subsequent countermeasures
choices.risk_hint: If Ye Qing sees through the disguise, she may turn hostile and attack on the spot

dialogue.content: The Saintess should calm her anger, Chen is merely a servant disciple—what virtue do I have to dare oppose the Saintess...

text.content:
At this moment, an elderly yet authoritative voice came from the depths of the main hall—Ling Yuan had somehow moved to the very front of the Mountain Gate, appearing in person. He gave Chen Ji a complex glance, then turned to Ye Qing, cupping his fist: 'The Saintess honors our Tianqing Sect; this sect naturally treats you with due courtesy. However, Chen Ji is merely a servant disciple—may the Saintess clarify the grudge between her and this person?'

This words seemed fair, but carried hidden daggers—he was clearly belittling Chen Ji as an insignificant figure before Ye Qing, trying to absolve the sect of responsibility.

Yet Chen Ji had long since made his calculations. Ling Yuan, oh Ling Yuan, the more you rush to push me away, the more it proves your guilty conscience. Today, I shall see exactly where this old fox's tail is hidden.

dialogue.content: (From the Tianji Record Fragment, Master Mo's residual soul's voice murmured) Little fellow, don't let emotions cloud your judgment. Ling Yuan has another scheme behind him—every word you speak now is being calculated by others.

text.content:
Master Mo's reminder was like a basin of cold water, extinguishing the rising killing intent in Chen Ji's heart. He took a deep breath, once again summoning that blurry foresight image in his Mental Sea—within three days, something major would happen at Tianqing Sect. And Ye Qing's arrival seemed to be one of the triggers for this vision.

Hourglass: 1 hour 41 minutes.

Time was passing. And he must, within three hours, breathe life into this chess game.

He raised his head, meeting Ye Qing's scrutinizing gaze, and smiled faintly: 'Elder Ling speaks too harshly. Though Chen is merely a servant disciple, I too know what faith means. The words from seven days ago, I etched them here.' As he spoke, he pointed to his own chest, 'If the Saintess has questions, perhaps she should speak them.'

dialogue.content: Fine. Then this Saintess asks you—what makes you think this Foundation Buildingtrash deserves an 'equal' alliance with me?

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's pressure bore down like a collapsing mountain; Chen Ji had to give her a convincing answer—

choices.description: Directly disclose the internal power struggle within the Demonic Path Holy Sect, proving equal status through intelligence value.
choices.visible_cost: Consume Tianji Record Fragment prediction attempts (Heavenly Fate -5)
choices.visible_reward: Display an intelligence network beyond the Saintess's understanding, establish foundation for equal dialogue
choices.risk_hint: Expose part of the Tianji Record's truth, may attract pursuit from Holy Sect higher-ups

dialogue.content: Did the Saintess truly come only to kill a servant disciple? Perhaps—the Holy Master's deadline for you wasn't thirty days?

text.content: Ye Qing's expression changed dramatically. The deadline the Holy Master gave her—fifteen days. This was internal classified information of the Holy Sect, known to no one else but herself. Yet thistrash spoke of it as if reciting something trivial. Hourglass in Mental Sea: 1 hour 35 minutes.

choices.description: Neither servile nor arrogant, use spirit and bearing to overwhelm the opponent, making the Saintess realize he is no soft persimmon to be squeezed.
choices.visible_reward: Establish prestige before the crowd, enhance reputation within the sect
choices.risk_hint: If momentum fails to convince, may be humiliated by the Saintess on the spot

dialogue.content: The Saintess thinks Chen istrash? Then what is it that allows atrash to predict someone's stumble within seven breaths?

text.content: These words一出, everyone was shocked. The surrounding Tianqing Sect disciples' view of Chen Ji changed completely—from contempt to unbelievable astonishment. Even in Su Qingyao's beautiful eyes, a complex expression flickered. This servant disciple... exactly how many trump cards was he hiding?

Ye Qing fell silent.

She examined the gray-robed youth before her, her gaze like examining a deep, unfathomable treasure. That previous prophecy—the Demonic Path envoy's public stumble—was by no means coincidence nor prearranged. That was genuine, extraordinary foresight ability.

And this ability was precisely what she needed most.

'You're interesting.' Ye Qing finally spoke, the killing intent in her tone already faded considerably, replaced by an almost greedy scrutiny, 'This Saintess will give you one chance. But you must prove your ability... is worth this Saintess taking this risk.'

She slowly raised her right hand, her fingertips condensing a mass of ghostly purple demonic flame. That was the untransmitted ultimate technique of the Demonic Path Holy Sect—'Heart-Devouring Demonic Flame.' Once released, it could completely incinerate a Golden Core stage cultivator's meridians within three breaths.

'This is one-tenth of this Saintess's strength. If you can withstand it, the alliance can be discussed.'

In the Mental Sea, the hourglass suddenly accelerated: 1 hour 29 minutes.

dialogue.content: If the Saintess wishes to test Chen's abilities, why must she act personally?

text.content:
Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, facing that ball of demonic flame sufficient to reduce a Golden Core cultivator to ash, yet his expression showed not a trace of fluctuation. His gaze passed over Ye Qing, falling upon the Demonic Path envoy behind her who had just scrambled up, face full of shame and indignation.

'That envoy from earlier seems very dissatisfied with Chen.' Chen Ji smiled faintly, 'Why not let him test it for the Saintess?'

Ye Qing slightly startled, then coldly smiled: 'You wish to use this Saintess's person to prove yourself?'

'Dare not.' Chen Ji shook his head, his tone sincere to the point of naivety, 'It's just that Chen's resources are limited—I wouldn't dare waste a single bit. Using him to face a Demonic Path envoy is already the greatest sincerity Chen can offer the Saintess.'

These words seemed like showing weakness, but carried hidden daggers—he was clearly saying: I'm not afraid to receive your moves, just unwilling to bother.

Everyone present gasped.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's killing intent intertwined with appreciation; Chen Ji had to make his final stance—

choices.description: Proactively make concessions, giving Ye Qing a step down, while revealing specific conditions for cooperation, displaying sincerity and strength.
choices.visible_reward: Establish initial trust with Ye Qing, lay foundation for deep cooperation within seven days
choices.risk_hint: If concessions are too great, may be seen as weak and exploitable, weakening subsequent negotiation leverage

dialogue.content: If the Saintess insists on testing, Chen will accept. But before making a move, please allow Chen to say one thing—the thing the Saintess truly seeks is not at Tianqing Sect.

text.content:
Ye Qing's hand suddenly froze. That Heart-Devouring Demonic Flame at her fingertips flickered once, showing signs of dissipating. 'What did you say?' Her voice was extremely low, low enough that only Chen Ji could hear, 'How do you know—'

In the Mental Sea, hourglass: 1 hour 21 minutes.

choices.description: Directly receive Ye Qing's test, display true strength beyond surface cultivation, completely subdue the Demonic Path Holy Saintess.
choices.visible_cost: Consume Heavenly Fate (-5) for protection, may expose more trump cards
choices.visible_reward: Completely intimidate Ye Qing, alliance conditions will be entirely led by Chen Ji
choices.risk_hint: Directly receiving the Demonic Path Holy Saintess's move may trigger chain reactions, exposing the Tianji Record's protective functions

text.content:
Chen Ji did not dodge or evade, allowing that ball of Heart-Devouring Demonic Flame to strike his chest—however, the instant the demonic flame touched his skin, a layer of pale golden light barrier suddenly appeared, completely deflecting the demonic flame, dispersing it into purple specks that vanished into the air.

The entire Mountain Gate fell utterly silent.

dialogue.content: This light barrier—this is not something a Foundation Building cultivator should possess!

text.content:
Regardless of Chen Ji's choice, Ye Qing's reaction proved one thing—this seemingly delicate Demonic Path Holy Saintess was far more complex than she appeared. She was both a chess piece controlled by the Holy Sect, and a key figure attempting to turn the tables in this game of chess.

And Chen Ji, after seeing through this point, dared to reveal his trump cards one by one before her.

He clearly understood that cooperation with Ye Qing from the beginning was never 'Holy Saintess bestowing favor upontrash,' but two people caught by fate, finding each other inevitably in chaotic times.

Deep in the Mental Sea, Master Mo's voice rang out again, carrying a rare hint of praise: 'Not bad. You're more composed than this old man anticipated.'

Chen Ji did not answer. He only looked up at Ye Qing, the corner of his mouth curving into a meaningful arc.

'Saintess, pleasant cooperation.'

Ye Qing's gaze lingered on Chen Ji's face for a long while before finally coldly harrumphing, retracting the demonic flame at her fingertips: 'Pleasant cooperation? Not even the first word is settled, yet you dare speak such words?'

But her tone had already softened considerably from the beginning.

At this moment, the hourglass in the Mental Sea slightly paused—1 hour 15 minutes.

Simultaneously, an extremely concealed divine sense shot out from the crowd, precisely locking onto Chen Ji's back.

It was Elder Zhou. The insider.

Who was he communicating with?

Chen Ji's eyes flickered, and he already had calculations in mind. Ling Yuan's scheme was far deeper than he had imagined. And this chess game had only just begun.

Ye Qing released a Demonic Path pressure with a cold smile, and Chen Ji's Mental Sea hourglass had finished one shichen—the remaining time was passing at an almost cruel speed.
